policy: Additive sphere-specific criteria declared before the first spherical PDE run or unit test. Keep the original acceptance.json and its existing names/bounds unchanged. Retain failed runs; do not adjust any threshold after observing results. Neither the solution nor the boundary flux is corrected by the diagnostic bias.

per_grid: spherical-n{N}: mass temporal bias identity relative
spherical-n{N}: energy temporal bias identity relative

definitions.bias_reason: For fixed rho0=|u0|=R=1 in d=3, boundary mass influx is (1+t)^2. The SSPRK2 two-stage trapezoidal integral has a positive excess sum(dt^3)/6. Energy influx is half the mass influx. This is the temporal boundary quadrature bias, not loss of discrete mass/energy conservation.
definitions.core_density_l1: sum_{r_right<=.70*r_shock} V_i*abs(rho_i-rho_exact_cellavg_i) / sum_{same} V_i*rho_exact_cellavg_i; includes the origin without a center exclusion
definitions.finite_center_diagnostics: At every N save finite first-cell rho,p,sie and their exact-state ratios; center max sie, min rho, max p and their exact-state ratios. Existing center mask r_right<=.25*r_shock is retained.
definitions.signed_diagnostics: Keep signed mass/energy differences, signed balance residuals and signed temporal-bias residuals alongside absolute relative gate values.

expected_spherical_reference.measure: r^2 dr, common angular factor omitted

non_gates: L2 and Linf are recorded diagnostics, without monotonicity gates.
Center maximum heating is recorded, with no zero-error or monotonicity gate.
The original base gates (including full-domain density L1, shock position, plateau and analytic inflow total errors) apply to d=3 without relaxed bounds.
